text:
morgan: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — can leadership confirm expected quarters for the API/Console/Optimize pieces we discussed? Trying to align OKRs.

elaine: Thanks for raising. High-level summary from exec: 
- API (hosted endpoints): GA for function/tool-calls = Q3 (internal beta late Q2).
- Console (rollouts + per-route analytics): progressive release starting Q3, GA end of Q4.
- Optimize (batching suggestions, quant profiles, quant dashboard): v1 pilot Q4, GA early next year.
Note: Dedicated/Private releases typically trail hosted by ~1 quarter due to partner integrations.

devon: Quick clarifying q: does "Console rollouts" include the canary traffic-split UI or just backend rollout APIs?
patrick: We really need the canary UI for platform teams to adopt; backend-only won't cut it.
elaine: Canary UI is in scope for the Console rollout. devon + patrick to sync with eng-platform and product.

sara: Any breaking config changes for customers using custom routing? We should add migration notes to docs.
morgan: Good catch — plan is backward-compatible defaults; advanced routing config will be opt-in with migration docs.
kris: For Dedicated customers, will Optimize recommendations run on-prem in the initial release?
elaine: Not in v1. Optimize recommendations will be hosted-first; on-prem connectors and private mode planned for v1.1.

morgan: Action items captured: 1) Product to publish a one-pager with quarter-level timelines + gating criteria by EOD Friday. 2) Eng to assign owners for canary UI + API compatibility tests and docs.
patrick: I'll take ownership of the canary UI. @devon, can you help with the API compatibility test matrix?
devon: Yep — I'll draft a matrix and share early next week, include edge cases for kv-cache and seq length.

deploy-bot: Reminder: release-cadence channel will receive weekly roadmap updates starting next Monday.
kris: Can we also get a list of impacted SDKs and expected semver bumps in that one-pager?
elaine: Yes — include SDK compatibility notes and migration snippets.

morgan: Thanks everyone. If folks want a quick sync, I'm happy to set a 30m breakout later this week.
patrick: +1
sara: :thumbsup:
elaine: :eyes:
